findings.title: Overlapping global and cue limits are not enforced together
findings.summary: The victim selector steals a low-priority voice outside the full cue, leaving two voices for a cue capped at one while the global cap remains respected. Ancestor bus aggregation is a separate policy question.
findings.review_note: Independent evidence review confirmed the bounded cap violation; downgraded High to Medium. Ancestor cap inheritance is not explicitly promised.

findings.title: Bar transitions miss boundaries crossed by a long frame
findings.summary: At 60 BPM, schedule bar transition from scene one after update at position 0, then move leader to 5.1 seconds. Bar 1 is emitted but the transition remains pending in scene one.

findings.title: Looping music stops emitting beats after the first playback cycle
findings.summary: Default music layers loop. Advance leader to 3.9, wrap to 0.1, then advance to 1.1. Beat count stays 4 because runtime.beat retains the previous cycle maximum.

findings.title: Loop regions are ignored when a scene has no BPM
findings.summary: Create an immediate scene with loopRegion={start=1,finish=2}, no BPM or analysis, and a source at 2.1. update leaves its position at 2.1 instead of seeking to 1.

findings.title: snapshot analysis state is not detached
findings.summary: Assign snapshot.analysis.fake="corrupted", then take another snapshot. The new snapshot contains fake="corrupted" because analysis returns the internal status table directly.

findings.title: Zero duration lists hang playback
findings.summary: Accepted durations={0,0} causes update(0.1) to loop without consuming time.

findings.title: pauseAtStart stops on final frame
findings.summary: Lowering disables looping and runtime bypasses the named loop method.

findings.title: Loop callbacks lose multi-wrap counts
findings.summary: Callbacks always receive 1 per forward wrap, making documented loops > 1 condition unreachable.

findings.title: Chained constructor property reads escape builtin lowering
findings.summary: Accepted vec2(3,4).normalized is emitted unchanged, fails with nil global vec2, and does not bundle the runtime.

findings.title: Game-math helper injection misses comments and bracket members
findings.summary: math. --comment newline clamp(...) and math["clamp"](...) build successfully but execute without the required helper.

findings.title: Nonzero tiny vector divisors incorrectly raise zero-component error
findings.summary: The zero guard multiplies components; 1e-200 * 1e-200 underflows, rejecting valid component-wise division.

findings.title: Normalization collapses finite large and small vectors to zero
findings.summary: Vectors (1e200,0) and (1e-200,0) normalize to (0,0) rather than (1,0) through overflow/underflow in squared length.

findings.title: Aliasing Camera skips runtime injection
findings.summary: check and build succeed, but runtime crashes indexing nil C; build emits only one file, without tuacamera.lua.

findings.title: Rotated views escape world bounds
findings.summary: Center clamps to (400,300), but visibleBounds starts at (-94.9747,-194.9747).

findings.title: Pixel-perfect drawing and coordinate conversion disagree
findings.summary: Drawing puts the camera center at (201,151), while toScreen returns (200.5,150.5).

findings.title: visibleBounds excludes part of the shaken view
findings.summary: Visible top-left is (-408.1951,-294.8351), but reported bounds are (-400,-300,800,600), omitting visible pixels on the left.

findings.title: Platformer preset contradicts documented deadzone proportions
findings.summary: Deadzone is 100 pixels wide and 200 high; source annotation and docs describe wide horizontally and short vertically.

findings.title: Callback cancellation can crash tween updates
findings.summary: Stopping self or another tween from callbacks invalidates live update indices; onstart cancellation also still mutates the target.

findings.title: Shorthand after accepts invalid duration
findings.summary: The merged after annotation treats shorthand seconds as any; build succeeds but Lua crashes, and signature help describes the wrong argument.

findings.title: Flattening constructor self references loses object identity
findings.summary: A Self field assigned self passes check/build but optimized constructor emits an unbound self; the required field is nil. A local-capture control preserves identity.

findings.title: Dictionary dot writes bypass the value contract
findings.summary: Invalid string mutation of a number dictionary passes CLI/LSP and crashes emitted Lua; bracket writes reject.

findings.title: Existing-local reassignment skips missing RHS slots
findings.summary: Residual of prior TYP-05 value-list family: n,s=2 leaves required string nil, accepted by CLI/LSP and crashes emitted Lua.

findings.title: Short callbacks reject ignored trailing arguments
findings.summary: Consolidates STORES-01/POOLS-03; ordinary inferred and annotated callbacks fail shared function assignability.

findings.title: Optional record fields reject nil deletion
findings.summary: Consolidates STORES-02; shared assignment-target resolver drops optional flag.

findings.title: Return expressions skip call validation without matching result slots
findings.summary: Module returns and excess return expressions accept invalid typed arguments; local and ordinary function-return controls reject.

findings.title: Default expressions bypass declared parameter types
findings.summary: A number parameter with string default builds with no LSP diagnostics and crashes arithmetic at runtime.

findings.title: Explicit nil rejected for defaulted parameters
findings.summary: Documented nil-triggered default semantics work in emitted runtime but are rejected by CLI and LSP.

findings.title: Inline require field extraction loses types
findings.summary: Inline require field extraction loses types

findings.title: Imported ECS component loses payload schema
findings.summary: Imported ECS component loses payload schema

findings.title: Declaration overlay disagrees across hover, signature and result inference
findings.summary: Declaration overlay disagrees across hover, signature and result inference

findings.title: Documented metatable colon call rejected
findings.summary: Lua constructor instance method loses implicit receiver semantics; CLI and LSP reject valid colon call although forced output runs correctly.

findings.title: Lua exports discard overload call contracts
findings.summary: Local overloaded call rejects boolean, but equivalent required Lua export accepts it and exposes only any signature.

findings.title: Known void LOVE call chains pass checking and fail at runtime
findings.summary: Text:set(...):getWidth() passes CLI and LSP checks, though LOVE 11.5 raises nil-index and LSP correctly suppresses post-void completion/signature help.

findings.title: Unannotated LOVE callback parameters remain any
findings.summary: update dt and keypressed key/isrepeat hover any despite generated catalog signatures; declaration validation works and docs do not promise contextual body inference.

findings.title: Pipeline output-root change overwrites unowned source files
findings.summary: Relative-only materialized ownership persists across output-root changes, allowing silent replacement of user-authored files.

findings.title: Corrupted cached output bytes are materialized without rebuild
findings.summary: Cache-hit validation only checks file presence/type, contrary to documented corrupt-cache recovery.

findings.title: Macro-defined uniform names trigger false missing-uniform errors
findings.summary: Valid GLSL macro-expanded alpha uniform is rejected as absent; metadata records macro identifier NAME despite documented conservative handling.

findings.title: Formatting removes semantic whitespace on multiline long-string opening lines
findings.summary: CLI and LSP document/range/on-type formatting trim two literal spaces from [[a  \nb]], changing cleanly built Lua runtime length from 5 to 3. CRLF reproduces; interior-line control preserves the value.

findings.title: Safe unused-local fix deletes neighboring same-line statements
findings.summary: Remove unused local and source.fixAll delete the entire line, losing independent print calls before or after the declaration.

findings.title: Explicit import cleanup changes module initialization effects and order
findings.summary: Explicit remove-unused and organize imports drop runtime module effects and may reorder initializers. No violation asserted; safe fix-all leaves imports intact.

findings.title: Structured reports hide backend startup diagnostics
findings.summary: When Busted cannot launch the selected Lua interpreter or initialize coverage, --report returns a generic missing-report error before exposing captured backend stderr. Test Explorer always uses --report, obscuring actionable configuration failures. Incomplete reports remain safe.

findings.title: Special-case cleanup deletes files without build ownership
findings.summary: In-place declaration build silently deletes handwritten sibling types.d.lua; declaration and disabled-map cleanup bypass manifest ownership and source-overlap protection.

findings.title: dev retains stale output root after configuration reload
findings.summary: Changing out rebuilds new directory but dev instruments and signals original directory, leaving new output without hot reload.

findings.title: New conf.lua is never tracked for restart after startup
findings.summary: Absent initial conf.lua is stored as nil, so creation and later edits never enter the restart comparison.

findings.title: Spaces in generated paths disable traceback remapping
findings.summary: CLI and extension traceback tokenizers stop at whitespace, losing valid generated paths despite correct source maps; actual Lua class traceback and extension helper reproduce.

findings.title: Colon string completion enumerates receiver internals
findings.summary: Explicit-self method completion selects receiver type and splits formatted nested unions into malformed candidates; independently reproduces audio symptom.

findings.title: Shader hover nests GLSL Markdown in a Tua fence
findings.summary: Core shader hover is preformatted Markdown but LSP wraps it again as Tua.

findings.title: Same-arity overload selection ignores literal argument
findings.status: confirmed known; deduplicate INPUT-G01 and HOV-G01
findings.summary: Input move signature exists but scalar overload remains active.

findings.title: Sidebar graph cache does not follow unsaved or filesystem changes
findings.summary: Actual server responses update while sidebar cache remains unchanged until save/manual refresh; no explicit live sidebar refresh contract, so not counted as a defect.

findings.title: Project files omits Lua sources that Modules includes
findings.summary: Actual module graph includes interop.lua but production sidebar directory filtering excludes .lua; complete sidebar inventory is not explicitly promised.

findings.title: Refresh reuses analysis revisions across changed snapshots
findings.summary: Refresh reconstructs AnalysisHost; changed facts reuse revision 5 and clearing an overlay decreases 6 to 5.

findings.title: Project diagnostics omit new unsaved overlay files
findings.summary: Path-specific diagnostics reports the unsaved file type error but parameterless project diagnostics excludes it before and after refresh.

findings.title: JSON-RPC envelope and notification handling is inconsistent
findings.summary: Invalid version and object IDs are accepted; API and MCP initialization notifications receive id:null responses.

findings.title: Fused macOS app retains LOVE document-handler claim
findings.summary: Real LOVE 11.5a fusion removes exported type declarations but leaves CFBundleDocumentTypes advertising .love Owner handling, contrary to packaging documentation.

findings.title: Setup README omits the shipped shader step
findings.summary: Optional Editor Setup says all four steps and describes only theme, layout, icons and hints; the shipped manifest has a fifth shader step with workspace associations and optional highlighting installation. No runtime defect observed.
